learn.text: 35° + ? = 90°A right angle is 90°. If one part is 35°, the other part is 90 − 35 = 55°.A straight line is 180°.

cases.showNote: Two angles make a straight line.

steps.label: The whole angle
steps.ask: How many degrees is a straight line?[x]°
steps.hint: A right angle is a square corner: 90°. A straight line is two of them: 180°.
steps.explain: A right angle is a square corner: 90°. A straight line is two of them: 180°. That makes 180.
